RaceName: TRM Ironxcell For Energy Race
Spotlight: 7f winner in France; couple of solid runs for this yard, most notably when beaten 4l into fourth at Fairyhouse (7f, gd) in June; below that last twice, but has the rating to be involved and drop back in trip should suit.

RaceName: TRM Ironxcell For Energy Race
Spotlight: Good second on debut over C&D in October before going one better at Navan (6f, soft) ten days later; needed return at Cork and ran okay in premier handicap over C&D 86 days ago; could figure if stepping forward again.

RaceName: TRM Ironxcell For Energy Race
OwnerName: Mrs Michael J Byrne & Jerry P Murphy
Spotlight: Sole win in 20 starts came in Cork maiden in October 2024, but has been in excellent form this year in sprints, including runner-up efforts in Listed company over C&D (behind Mission Central) and Cork; never involved here 12 days ago, but type to bounce back and enjoys this track; the one to beat.

RaceName: TRM Ironxcell For Energy Race
OwnerName: Joseph E Keeling & Aidan Gleeson & M C Grassick
Spotlight: Solid runs in 6f maidens here and at the Curragh last year, finishing third and fourth; showed plenty of pace, but plenty to find after 291 days on the sideline.

RaceName: TRM Ironxcell For Energy Race
OwnerName: Kildare Racing Syndicate & Kilmichael Racing Syndicate
Spotlight: Produced a promising debut when fifth in strong Curragh maiden in May 2025 before going one better in excellent style when easily scoring at Dundalk by 3.25l; looked potentially very useful that day and a leading player, but has been off for nearly a year.

RaceName: TRM Ironxcell For Energy Race
Spotlight: Off the mark at the sixth attempt when scoring at Bellewstown (5f, good) last month, beating Sparky Sparky bu 2.75l; a mark of 75 seemed to sum her up the last twice, however, so more needed here.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Made an encouraging debut when third of seven in a similar contest over C&D (good to firm) last Monday; can be expected to show improvement which is more than likely required here.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Has shown just a modest level of ability in his two runs so far and has his work cut out here; his best chance of success in the immediate future probably lies in nurseries.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: A 200,000gns breeze-up buy, he ran a stormer when beaten a nose on his debut at Pontefract (5f, good to firm) eight days ago, looking a winner-in-waiting; steps up in trip and should be hard to beat.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Solid form when placed in his two runs so far; first-time blinkers replace cheekpieces and he should be suited by stepping back up to 6f; looks the main danger.

RaceName: www.mourneabbeyoil.ie Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Pulled up on debut in a Fairyhouse bumper in December and similar story on hurdles bow at Listowel six months later; look elsewhere.

RaceName: www.mourneabbeyoil.ie Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Off the mark at the third attempt in bumpers in a Listed heat at Fairyhouse in April; weakened into an 8.5l fourth on hurdles debut at Kilbeggan 24 days ago; not discounted but needs to improve on that to win this.

RaceName: www.mourneabbeyoil.ie Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Punchestown bumper winner (2m, gd-yld) on debut in October; pulled up on heavy ground in Listed bumper at Navan a month later; raced too keenly when beaten favourite on hurdles bow at Punchestown; let backers down again when beaten 21l into fourth here on latest; overlooked by Townend.

RaceName: www.mourneabbeyoil.ie Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Made it 2-2 in bumpers when scoring by a head at Punchestown in May; won on debut here by 0.75l; from a good jumping family and she's preferred by Paul Townend; may prove hard to beat.

RaceName: www.mourneabbeyoil.ie Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: 0-7 in point-to-points, failing to complete in five of them; best watched on Rules' debut.

RaceName: www.mourneabbeyoil.ie Mares Maiden Hurdle
OwnerName: John J Flynn, Pierce Flynn, Conor Lannen
Spotlight: Bumper winner; 0-4 over hurdles and rated 104; fine run when second at Listowel in June (2m, yielding); weakened upped to 2m7f on latest; drop back in trip here is a plus; place chance if reproduces that Listowel effort.

RaceName: www.mourneabbeyoil.ie Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Standout effort a staying on third at Punchestown in January (16.5f, sft-hvy); suffered overreach when pulled up at Limerick a month later; may have needed latest when well beaten here after 89 days off but others look more solid.

RaceName: www.mourneabbeyoil.ie Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Point-to-point winner last November but lost way in that sphere subsequently and no impact in maiden hurdles at Downpatrick and Wexford; hard to fancy.

RaceName: www.mourneabbeyoil.ie Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Ran okay when fifth of 18 in a Clonmel maiden hurdle in May; another respectable run on the Flat at Leopardstown on latest; was running well when falling in a maiden hurdle here last year; could go well at a price.

RaceName: www.mourneabbeyoil.ie Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: 80-1 and tailed off on debut at Listowel two months ago; put a line through.

RaceName: www.mourneabbeyoil.ie Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Beat just one rival home when an 80-1 shot here on debut last year; hard to fancy on that effort.

RaceName: www.mourneabbeyoil.ie Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Off the mark at the fifth attempt in point-to-points in mares' maiden at Tyrella in March; hood goes on for hurdles debut; probably best watched.

RaceName: www.mourneabbeyoil.ie Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Failed to make any impact in maiden hurdles at Gowran and Clonmel for former yard; tongue tie applied for stable debut; others appeal more.

RaceName: www.mourneabbeyoil.ie Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Punchestown bumper winner had no apparent excuses when beaten 32l on hurdling debut at Listowel last month; surely capable of better than that but overlooked by Townend.

RaceName: www.mourneabbeyoil.ie Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Tailed off in a maiden hurdle here 24 days ago; may need more time

RaceName: www.mourneabbeyoil.ie Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Pulled up here on debut and heavy defeats at big prices in both starts since over hurdles; not easy to make a case for on form.

RaceName: www.mourneabbeyoil.ie Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: 66-1 and pulled up on debut at Listowel in June; can only be watched after that tame effort.

RaceName: www.mourneabbeyoil.ie Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Unseated early on debut at Roscommon; tailed off at Ballinrobe when 125-1 on latest; needs more time and experience.

RaceName: Weatherbys Digital Solutions Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Solid debut behind a couple of useful fillies last autumn but then wasn't seen again until a fortnight ago, when easy to back (1m2f); again finished third to a couple of useful fillies at Newbury and holds decent claims with that under her belt.

RaceName: Weatherbys Digital Solutions Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Again inclined to pull hard in a C&D fillies' novice last time and no surprise to see a first-time hood fitted today; looking exposed now and will again be vulnerable to an improver, even if proving more amenable.

RaceName: Weatherbys Digital Solutions Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Second foal of a 7f 2yo winner for the Gosden yard (first offspring a winner in France and Spain); trainer gets the odd big-priced winning newcomer but she's likely one for handicaps down the line.

RaceName: Weatherbys Digital Solutions Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 50-1 when well held on her 6f Polytrack debut for Ed Walker last September; yard's Flat wins in recent times have all come with older horses and it would be a surprise to see her take this.

RaceName: Weatherbys Digital Solutions Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: She's run to a similar level all four starts, often pulling hard, including in the first-time hood (retained) back up to 1m last time; leading claims if she settles but it's now hard to be bullish on that front.

RaceName: Weatherbys Digital Solutions Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Needed the experienced on her debut and built on that when chasing home a long odds-on favourite, who's gone in again since, despite over-racing upped to 1m; should have more to offer.

RaceName: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap
Spotlight: Solid 3yo sprinter hasn't been hit hard for handicap wins over C&D in April and over 5f at the Curragh in June; back from a two-month spell, and perhaps he'll just come on for this run.

RaceName: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap
Spotlight: All three wins over 5f, including pair of Cork handicaps last summer; didn't threaten in valuable Curragh handicaps last twice, including over extended 6f last month; tongue-tie.

RaceName: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap
Spotlight: Dual winner over this trip last year and promising fourth over C&D on his return; not so good next twice, but decent fifth of 20 in Scurry Handicap (extended 6f) at the Curragh where couldn't go the pace at halfway before keeping on late; had three of these behind and it was a creditable showing on first start against his elders.

RaceName: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap
Spotlight: Just one win to his name, but has been second three times in five runs here; drops in grade after contesting premier handicaps at the Curragh (excuse two runs back) this season; drawn widest which is probably a slight negative, but it's all on the day as to which side they go at Naas; only 1lb higher than his winning mark.

RaceName: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap
Spotlight: Won a 6f Curragh maiden on yielding to soft last year; came on from reappearance when touched off by a subsequent Galway winner over 7f here; carries head high, and did so in that Curragh win, so that's just him and seems to give his all.

RaceName: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap
Spotlight: Has okay form on good and Polytrack, and goes well on straight tracks, but last couple of wins have been on testing terrain; outstayed over 7f when second at Cork, and 5f was a bit sharp latest; all three wins have been at 6f.

RaceName: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap
Spotlight: Won AW maiden over this trip on fourth start in December; 66s, short-lived appearance in the front rank before fading tamely in the Scurry; best watched for now.

RaceName: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap
Spotlight: Wins in his turn, albeit five of his six victories have been on AW; below par at Ayr last time, but solid runs in 6f turf handicaps earlier in the summer; this is start number 16 of the year.

RaceName: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs S Bury & Ralph Kelly & Odhran O'Neill & Thomas Cox
Spotlight: Was a long-standing maiden over middle distances, but dam was a capable sprinter and dropping him back to 6f in a pair of blinkers has done the trick; followed up breakthrough win at Navan when winning in only slightly lower grade here; prominent racer got an uncontested lead then, but might have more to offer nonetheless.

RaceName: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap
Spotlight: Classy performer back in the day; couple of okay runs over 7f for this yard, but was 8l behind Gotta Catch'em All over C&D when only a 6-1 poke; handicapper is giving him a chance, but visor needs to make an impact for him to be competitive.

RaceName: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap
Spotlight: Too Darn Hot colt with nice page was bought for 35,000gns last mointh; maiden after seven starts for Owen Burrows (beaten favourite all four handicap starts this term); touched off over 6f at Ffos Las when last seen in June.

RaceName: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 4yo who has achieved very little across her 17 winless starts and others are preferred.

RaceName: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Her dam was a 5f/6f winner for the yard (RPR 77) and it's very early days, but she was soundly beaten at big prices last autumn on her first two starts (6f/5f, AW) and this is her first outing since; improvement needed.

RaceName: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 11-race maiden who has finished second six times; needs to prove she can get the job done and it's possible that 5f is her optimum trip, but she has the best form in the field and this could be a good opportunity.

RaceName: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: One to watch in the betting in first-time cheekpieces but she's been beaten a long way on all five starts, for this stable on her last two runs.

RaceName: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Signs of promise on debut at Southwell last month (7f, AW; slowly away) and likewise when 4l third of seven at Redcar (7f, good to firm) last Wednesday; her useful pedigree hints that this drop in trip could be a positive, and she's firmly in calculations.

RaceName: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Went very close at 50-1 on debut at Leicester (6f, good to firm) in May; failed to back that up at Bath (5.7f, good) but she lost a shoe and has had a break since; remains of interest.

RaceName: John O'Flynn Motors 110 Series Final Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Both wins have been on good ground, notably last month in 2m4f handicap here, surviving stewards enquiry after hanging left on run-in and hampering second; up 6lb for that and cheekpieces now added to usual tongue-tie.

RaceName: John O'Flynn Motors 110 Series Final Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Series of placed efforts (including twice here) rewarded by 2m1f Limerick win early last month under enterprising ride, kept wide and making all in beating Dairy Force an eased 15l (good); 12lb hike makes this a lot tougher and unlikely to be given such leeway this time.

RaceName: John O'Flynn Motors 110 Series Final Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Improved significantly on better ground and reportedly settled better when getting up late to land 2m2f Sligo maiden in June; didn't land a meaningful blow on handicap debut at Galway a week ago, however, so lots more needed.

RaceName: John O'Flynn Motors 110 Series Final Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Finally made the breakthrough in 2m3f Downpatrick maiden in June (good) at the 35th attempt; most recently just okay effort at Kilbeggan back in handicap company; more needed.

RaceName: John O'Flynn Motors 110 Series Final Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Point-to-point winner got off the mark hurdling at the 12th attempt when scoring over C&D last month, making much of running and finding plenty for pressure from last in a first-time hood; 7lb rise seems fair and another big run expected.

RaceName: John O'Flynn Motors 110 Series Final Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Bumper winner in 2024; 0-9 hurdling, most recently just behind a couple of today's rivals when seventh of 20 at Galway a week ago over this trip; has to improve to feature.

RaceName: John O'Flynn Motors 110 Series Final Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Has mixed it between Flat and hurdles effectively this year, winning on the level at Sligo and only worn down close home in 2m Galway handicap hurdle on Saturday; obvious chance if turning out quickly.

RaceName: John O'Flynn Motors 110 Series Final Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Flat winner won a 2m1f Wexford handicap hurdle in May (good-to-yielding) and okay runs twice since off 9lb higher; can be keen.

RaceName: John O'Flynn Motors 110 Series Final Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won 2m1f Clonmel handicap in April (yielding) and mixed form since, notably third the last twice, at Wexford and when not quite getting home behind Max Meridius over 2m2f at Ballinrobe in a first-time tongue-tie.

RaceName: John O'Flynn Motors 110 Series Final Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Limerick win last year (for Aengus King) her sole success, but good run on most recent of two runs for current yard, clear of remainder when beaten 1l over this trip at Killarney last month (good); 4lb higher now but could go well.

RaceName: John O'Flynn Motors 110 Series Final Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Returned from Flat to get off the mark last month when well-supported in 2m2f Ballinrobe handicap hurdle, keen and taking wide course but seeing it out well from the last (Le Diablo third); 8lb rise but 5yo could still have more improvement in him.

RaceName: Weatherbys Global Stallions App EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Big prices and well held in three runs to date (5f-7f), missing the break a couple of times; this is more realistic in a first-time tongue-tie but she again looks vulnerable.

RaceName: Weatherbys Global Stallions App EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: May-foaled 55,000euros 2yo (Irish breeze-ups) who has stamina on the dam's side of her pedigree and is likely to be suited by more of a test in due course; stable had a big-priced 2yo newcomer win last week; watch the market.

RaceName: Weatherbys Global Stallions App EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Well held after a slow start on her 6f debut, and again last time, when pulling hard in front over 7f and not seeing it out; nurseries may be her time to shine in due course.

RaceName: Weatherbys Global Stallions App EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 290,000euros yearling whose French-trained dam won on her 6f 2yo debut; trainer, who also saddles Harlequin Gift, has enjoyed a decent season with juveniles and she's an interesting newcomer.

RaceName: Weatherbys Global Stallions App EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Stable in flying form of late, albeit mainly with older horses; this filly needed the experience on her Salisbury debut a fortnight ago, when well off the front pair; entitled to improve but needs to.

RaceName: Weatherbys Global Stallions App EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 75,000euros 2yo (Irish breeze-ups) who's a sister to Irish 2yo winner Ex Animo and a half-sister to Serenity Prayer (won on 3yo debut); the market will be the best guide.

RaceName: Weatherbys Global Stallions App EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: April-foaled 30,000gns yearling who's a half-sister to a useful sprint winner (turf) in the US; trainer enjoying a fine summer with 2yos and the market is usually a reliable guide with his newcomers.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Placed three times in maidens in Britain two years ago; never figured in two handicap starts over 5f and 7f for this stable, so hard to fancy.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Nine-time winner, five on turf; latest win came here over 6f in May 2025 off 7lb higher; second over C&D here in June, faded late into fifth when beaten favourite here last month; slowly away when ninth at Curragh; not out of it.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Back-to-back wins on good ground over 5f at Navan and Down Royal in summer of 2024; not been close to that form over last two years and continues to slide in the weights.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Improving in handicaps, keeping on to take third at Bellewstown before being beaten 0.75l by Viamonte at Down Royal 17 days ago; had some of his main rivals behind him that day, so should be in the mix off 2lb higher.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Proving consistent in handicaps this year; handled drop back to 5f at Down Royal 17 days ago, coming home well to grab third behind Dandy Land; shaped well that day from a less than ideal position, so capable of turning the tables.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Improved when fourth behind Dandy Land and Hot To Foxtrot at Down Royal last time on first start for this yard; should improve for that, but needs to reverse the form.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win in 13 starts came in 6f Sligo handicap a year ago, scoring cosily by 2.5l; positive third on AW in September but below par on turf return 23 days ago; needs to come on for that dropped back in trip.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Built on positive sixth over C&D to get off the mark at Navan (5f, good) 23 days ago, value for more than the 0.5l margin as idled when hitting the front; 10lb rise harsh, however, and needs another step forward to defy new mark.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Landed 20-runner handicap over C&D in June off 4lb lower, beating Tawaazon by 0.5l; two solid fifths since, showed up well for a long way over 6f ten days ago; in the mix.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Produced a positive third in small field over 5f in Dundalk maiden in December; little to recommend since in three starts, including on turf at Sligo last time.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Four-time winner has struggled since 6f Navan win in October; 7lb lower mark now, but needs to bounce back.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Has been consistent without looking well treated this year; not beaten far by Platino Bianco here over 5f in June; short of room when beaten favourite at Bellewstown 31 days ago; each-way chance.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
OwnerName: Scott Sterling & Darragh Cuffe & Conor Keohane
Spotlight: Some mild promise in AW maidens, but no obvious signs she's ready strike off this mark in three handicap runs so far; blinkers go on down in trip.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: 24-race maiden; has been consistent in the last year, making the frame on several occasions, including when fourth here over 6f last July; solid runs the last three times over 6f and 7f; mark seems to just about sum him up however, so needs drop in trip to bring improvement.

RaceName: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: C&D winner three years ago; two positive runs when fourth over 6f earlier in the summer and not beaten far at Fairyhouse over same trip 33 days ago; drop back to 5f unsure to suit though, and  well held over C&D twice in the last year.

RaceName: Weatherbys Bloodstock Pro Fillies' Handicap
OwnerName: Grange Park Racing Xviii And Ruth Carr
Spotlight: She'd run some good races in defeat this year for the Newland/Insole yard prior to being sold for 12,000gns last month, and she exploited a reduced mark on her stable debut at Thirsk (5f, good to firm); she had just a neck to spare and is back up 4lb but could have more to offer for the yard.

RaceName: Weatherbys Bloodstock Pro Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Made all in a novice at Yarmouth (6f, soft) in May in first-time blinkers; merely seventh subsequently in her first two handicaps (7f/6f, good to firm) but she showed plenty of pace over 6f at Carlisle on the second occasion and could relish this first crack at 5f; cheekpieces replace blinkers.

RaceName: Weatherbys Bloodstock Pro Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Won over C&D (good) in May and perhaps the return to Ripon will be a positive; however, she's been unplaced on her three starts since, most recently fourth to Zoustar Dreams at Nottingham, and she needs something extra.

RaceName: Weatherbys Bloodstock Pro Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Progressive since these cheekpieces went on, winning two in a row (6f/5f, good to firm/soft) before fading into fourth at Newmarket (6f, good to firm), and she appreciated the return to 5f when winning at Nottingham (5f, good to firm) last time; did it nicely and a 5lb rise may not stop her.

RaceName: Weatherbys Bloodstock Pro Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Won Newcastle maiden (5f, AW) last November on final 2yo start; close fifth on reappearance at Catterick (6f, good) in May before heavy defeat here later that month (6f, good; failed to settle); the drop back to 5f could help and she's not written off, but others arrive with less to prove.

RaceName: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Standout run from five attempts hurdling when second in 2m Kilbeggan maiden in May, poor run there on latest however in first-time cheekpieces, blundering badly two out; opposable on handicap debut.

RaceName: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Mild bumper promise in Britain as a 5yo but interrupted hurdles campaign for current yard, absent since tailed off in Listowel maiden last September; likely best watched on handicap debut after such an absence, although encouraging jockey booking and worth a market check.

RaceName: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Runner-up in 1m4f handicap at Doncaster at three for Charlie Johnston; lightly raced for this yard, last of 7 on last month's comeback run on the Flat; reverts to hurdles for handicap debut having had three runs in 4yo maidens last year; market best guide.

RaceName: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Maiden's best run came in C&D handicap last month when a staying on third of 23 (good); 2lb higher but can go well.

RaceName: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: AW winner last autumn has returned with a couple of solid runs in 2m handicap hurdles on good ground of late, third at Roscommon and kept on well from last to chase home a 3l winner at Wexford; 3lb higher now but definite player.

RaceName: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Limerick handicap hurdle win came back in 2024 off 94; couple of ordinary efforts in May and has had time off since.

RaceName: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Gained a first win at Wexford last summer off 81 (2m1f, good) and entitled to come on for last month's comeback run at Roscommon, albeit plenty to find with Syosset on that effort.

RaceName: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: 0-7 hurdling with John McConnell, absent since tailed off on heavy at Gowran in January; can only be watched on yard debut.

RaceName: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Maiden in decent form last autumn over fences but pulled up on return to action in May; reverts to hurdles but hard to be confident in.

RaceName: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Off for almost two years after winning at Thurles in 2022; returned from another long absence with mildly encouraging effort at Kilbeggan last month; entitled to improve for that and worth a market check off career-low mark.

RaceName: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Record of 1-22 on the Flat, winning good-ground 1m4f Tramore handicap last summer; four maiden hurdle runs have offered little but they were all on heavy ground so possibility of improvement on handicap debut here back on good ground.

RaceName: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Maiden in all spheres after 22 starts, standout recent effort when second in 2m2f Limerick handicap chase; penultimate Clonmel handicap hurdle fourth has worked out well so certainly can't be ruled out.

RaceName: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo whose five runs have all been on much softer ground, pulled up on handicap debut in February when last seen; may improve for this better ground, market may give us a clue.

RaceName: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Nothing as yet in four runs over hurdles, although attracted market support on handicap debut at Killarney last month, never counting in a first-time tongue-tie; may yet do better.

RaceName: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Nothing as yet in handicaps, absent since January.

RaceName: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Huge odds and well beaten in all six starts; back in trip here for handicap debut but hard to make a case for.

RaceName: Weatherbys VAT Services Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Pontefract win hasn't worked out and, having been out of his depth at Royal Ascot, he ran well below market expectations on his nursery debut a few weeks ago (buzzed up after getting crowded early); needs to settle better.

RaceName: Weatherbys VAT Services Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Didn't see out a stiff 7.4f following her 6f maiden win, but then appeared to have no excuses on her nursery debut last time (first-time tongue-tie; retained); looking exposed now.

RaceName: Weatherbys VAT Services Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Three defeats at short prices in the spring, including in a seller, before out of her depth in the Super Sprint last time; this is more realistic on her nursery debut but she needs to find more.

RaceName: Weatherbys VAT Services Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Better with each start, culminating in a neck defeat in a match at Ayr two weeks ago, having been gelded; hard to know the worth of that, with his sole rival a newcomer, but he may have more to offer under Marco Ghiani, who's 2-4 for the yard.

RaceName: Weatherbys VAT Services Nursery Handicap

Spotlight: Won a Downpatrick maiden hurdle last year for John McConnell; no show in first two starts for this yard and pulled up over 2m4f (good) here on latest; others more convincing.

RaceName: Jim Ryan Racecourse Services Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 0-13 over hurdles; ran on well for fourth on the Flat at Leopardstown (1m7f, good) on latest; well held on last start in this sphere at Galway just over a year ago but has placed off higher marks before so not discounted back over hurdles.

RaceName: Jim Ryan Racecourse Services Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: C&D maiden hurdle winner at this meeting in 2024; has shown virtually nothing since and was pulled up after losing action in first-time visor (discarded) when last sighted at Wexford in October.

RaceName: Jim Ryan Racecourse Services Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Left previous modest form behind when bolting up at Kilbeggan (2m3f, good) 10 days ago under positive ride; hiked up 10lb for that and this is a better race but he's unexposed in handicaps and there may be more to come from this 4yo.

RaceName: Jim Ryan Racecourse Services Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Three-time winner hasn't got her head in front since October 2024; runs of last winning mark but has failed to fire this season; last of six at Stratford on latest; new blinkers need to transform.

RaceName: Jim Ryan Racecourse Services Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: One okay run on the Flat for William Haggas; big odds and down field in three maiden hurdles for this yard; can only watch in first handicap hurdle.

RaceName: Jim Ryan Racecourse Services Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual-purpose maiden; extended hurdles record to 0-8 at Tramore 11 days ago but it wasn't a bad run in third; was still beaten over 7l, however, so needs more off the same mark here with cheekpieces added.

RaceName: Jim Ryan Racecourse Services Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Veteran hasn't won since August 2024; pulled up and beaten 48l in two starts since returning from a mammoth layoff; others make more appeal.

RaceName: Jim Ryan Racecourse Services Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Minor promise in maidens but pulled up on handicap debut here last month and needs to leave that behind.

RaceName: Weatherbys Racing Bank Handicap
Spotlight: Serial slow starter who ended a losing run off a 4lb lower mark at Doncaster 11 days ago before bumping into a well-handicapped winner over C&D last Thursday; holds claims, especially if he can get away on terms for a change.

RaceName: Weatherbys Racing Bank Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time Tapeta winner who's been expensive to follow in recent times; ridden more prominently than usual when below par last time but there have been too many near-misses for comfort.

RaceName: Weatherbys Racing Bank Handicap
Spotlight: Inconsistent maiden who has missed the start and/or pulled hard; no problem with 9.5f on Tapeta last time, when turning in his best effort since handicapping (made most), but history suggests he's no good thing to build on it.

RaceName: Weatherbys Racing Bank Handicap
Spotlight: Gelded after three ordinary efforts in maidens in the spring; solid effort in the first-time tongue-tie off this mark at Southwell last Monday, when a clear second, and his claims are obvious off the same mark.

RaceName: Weatherbys Racing Bank Handicap
OwnerName: Dr M Voikhansky & Mrs S Voikhanskaya
Spotlight: Dual winner for the Frost yard this time last year, latterly off 3lb lower, but has been absent since pulling away her chances over C&D in the spring; needs a revival.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Very modest sort based on 13 runs; can't make a case for.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: 4,000euros foal; Ribchester filly; half-sister to winners Starlight Dream (1m2f; RPR 93), Areana (10.5f; 72), Amethistos (Greek 6f/1m) and Abella (Slovakian 8.5f/1m6f); dam Italian Listed-placed 1m-1m2f winner.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Well held on first two starts on the AW; off 248 days; looks more one for handicaps.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Sea The Stars filly; half-sister to winners Starford (9.4f-1m3f inc Group 3; RPR 114) and Jack Sparowe (1m-1m3f inc AW; 80); dam 7f-1m4f winner (inc 2yo/Listed; 98), half-sister to useful 1m winner Laelaps, out of 1m3f-1m6f Flat and useful 2m hurdle winner; makes debut for in-form yard; second string on jockey bookings.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: Blue Point filly; closely related to 1m winner Embiran (RPR 94), half-sister to winners Elamaz (French/Australian 1m/1m2f inc Listed; 113), Emaniya (Group-placed 1m 2yo; 103) and Ediyva (7f AW; 74); dam 7f winner (inc Group 3/AW; 106); well-bred type from good Aga Khan family; market support would be interesting.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: 100,000euros foal (50,000euros vendor Y); second foal; half-sister to 1m4f winner Ledecky (RPR 86); dam 1m AW winner (Group-placed 1m4f; 99), closely related to Italian 1m7f Listed winner Fortunino, out of unraced close relation to 1m4f/1m6f Group 3 winner; yard 2-26 in maidens this year.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Well-bred filly, half-sister to yard's Grade 1 winner Aspen Grove; green when well held on debut over 7f on soft ground at Cork 121 days ago; likely improver up in trip but needs to.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: No indication she can win a maiden based on first three runs.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: J Kirkland & Mrs J M Ryan
Spotlight: Made the frame in all five starts, beaten 2.5l into third off 75 in 1m handicap at the Curragh before running to a similar level when filling the same spot at the Curragh 16 days ago over 7f; consistent and experienced; should go close back up in trip.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: Philip Antonacci & Mrs Paul Shanahan & Mrs John Magnier
Spotlight: Improved from debut, stepped up in trip after a break when fourth at the Curragh (7f, good-to-firm) 16 days ago, 1.25l behind Nautic Star; should appreciate this extra furlong on that evidence.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: 13,000euros yearling by Bungle Inthejungle; dam placed 7f/1m AW (RPR 65), half-sister to French winners Harmless (7f 2yo/1m2f Listed), Ghabnah (1m) and Samuraj (6f-1m), is granddaughter of German 1m Listed winner.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: No impact on debut six days ago; claims far from obvious.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: John G Hennessy & C Acheson & Mrs John Harrington
Spotlight: Well-held on debut at Down Royal 66 days ago; likely to improve for that but needs far more in cheekpieces.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Well beaten on debut 63 days ago; unlikely to figure.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Faded tamely on debut 52 days ago; drops in trip.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith
Spotlight: Best run at two came when beaten 4.5l into fifth by Diamond Necklace in Ingabelle Stakes (7f, good), albeit flattered by proximity to winner; beaten 6.25l into third in maiden at Galway in October on soft ground; used as pacemaker in Group 1 company last twice; obviously far calmer waters here, and her two-year-old form makes her the one to beat.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Huge odds and ran accordingly on debut nine days ago; hard to recommend.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Some promise amid greenness when beaten 10l into sixth on debut at Naas 30 days ago; tongue-tie on; more of a long-term project.

RaceName: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On Saturday August 29th INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Getaway 5yo cost 37,000euros as a foal and 19,000euros as a 3yo; first foal; dam bumper and 2m-2m2f hurdle/chase winner, sister to useful hurdle/chase winners Minella Foru (2m-3m) and Sumkindofking (2m-3m2f); noteworthy jockey booking for debut, worth a market check.

RaceName: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On Saturday August 29th INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Kingston Hill 5yo is second foal; dam placed in bumper/2m5f hurdle, half-sister to 2m4f-3m1f hurdle/chase winner Better Days; debutant probably best watched unless market speaks in his favour.

RaceName: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On Saturday August 29th INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Point-to-point winner but form in bumpers and maiden hurdles modest.

RaceName: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On Saturday August 29th INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Maxios half-brother to 2m4f hurdle winner Twin Power; dam useful 2m-3m hurdle/chase winner, sister to useful 2m-3m hurdle/chase winner Connectivity; newcomer has to be watched for market support.

RaceName: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On Saturday August 29th INH Flat Race
Spotlight: 35,000euros 3yo; half-brother to winners Mr Muldoon (useful hurdler/chaser) and Rajjamataz; dam points' winner; won Oldcastle point-to-point in March 2025 and following month ran well for a long way when creditable sixth of 18 in very valuable Goffs Defender Bumper at Punchestown festival for Stuart Crawford; reappears here for top yard and likely major player.

RaceName: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On Saturday August 29th INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Half-brother to bumper winner Pectora; dam unraced half-sister to smart bumper/2m hurdler Spirit Leader; soundly beaten on Leopardstown debut at Christmas, returning in May when didn't count, having raced keenly, at Clonmel; seems best watched.

RaceName: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On Saturday August 29th INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Doyen gelding; 21,000euros foal; dam unraced half-sister to high-class 2m-2m4f hurdler/chaser Kalashnikov; soon beaten on Punchestown debut in June when a 33-1 shot; eyecatching jockey booking now so worth a market check.

RaceName: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On Saturday August 29th INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Diamond Boy half-brother to three winners in France, including useful 2m1f-2m4f hurdler/chaser Le But; dam Flat/hurdles winner; ran twice in point-to-points before never counting in Ballinrobe bumper last month.

RaceName: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On Saturday August 29th INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Poet's Word half-brother to point winner; dam hunter chase/prolific point winner; disappointing favourite in Dromahane point-to-point last November; missed intended bumper debut last month due to good ground so likely will want rain.

RaceName: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On Saturday August 29th INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Recent Killarney fourth, in this headgear combination, represented an improvement; more likely required but definite place claims.

RaceName: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On Saturday August 29th INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Nice Newtown Anner Flat pedigree but Fascinating Rock gelding cost buttons at two; steady improvement in four bumpers, notably Kilbeggan third, most recently never nearer fourth (beaten under 3l) at Wexford last month on good ground; shortlisted.

RaceName: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On Saturday August 29th INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Crystal Ocean half-brother to four winners inc Annie Angel (useful 2m4f-3m chase), Myztique (bumper/2m2f hurdle) and Krujers Girl (2m3f-2m7f chase); dam unraced sister to useful 2m4f-3m2f hurdler/chaser Dun Doire; jockey booking encouraging, worth a market check on debut.

RaceName: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On Saturday August 29th INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Maxios 4yo cost 3,000euros as a foal; dam placed 8.5f-1m4f (RPR 71), half-sister to useful sprinters Doc Sportello and Bagamoyo; blinkered on debut, likely best watched.

RaceName: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On Saturday August 29th INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Idaho mare is fourth foal; dam runner-up in points/placed 2m3f hurdle, from family of useful staying chaser Dakyns Boy; newcomer best watched.

RaceName: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On Saturday August 29th INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Cloudings mare is sister to point-to-point winner Pluto's Gate, half-sister to four winners inc Geordie B (bumper and useful 2m7f-3m hurdle/chase), Amber Flush (2m7f/3m1f hurdle) and Lazy Sunday (2m3f-3m chase); dam 2m1f hurdle winner; placed in all three point-to-points last season.

RaceName: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On Saturday August 29th INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Signs of ability in point-to-points and in both bumpers, third at Listowel and just denied at Killarney last month (good), having travelled well but not finding as much as looked likely; tongue-tie added to hood now.

RaceName: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On Saturday August 29th INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Maiden in point-to-points and well held on rules debut in Punchestown maiden hurdle in June; switches to bumper and can only be watched.

RaceName: A1R Services Ltd Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Bumper/AW handicap winner; second of 13 here (1m2f, good to firm) in May under Georgia King and has since twice made the frame under the same rider, the latest when third of seven at Epsom (1m4f, good to firm) last month; still unexposed on turf and respected back down in grade.

RaceName: A1R Services Ltd Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Versatile sort having won on turf, AW and over hurdles; 2lb lower than for his last Flat success but this trip looks sharp enough; Ruby Criscuolo rode a winner for the stable at Wolverhampton last month; yard also runs Wrist Art.

RaceName: A1R Services Ltd Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Third start for new yard when winning at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) under Grace Littmoden in May; 4lb rise fair enough and the return to turf shouldn't be a problem back from a short break; shortlisted.

RaceName: A1R Services Ltd Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Latest defeat when sent off favourite here (1m2f, good to firm) a fortnight ago wasn't quite as bad as it looks, but his losing run is now up to 20 and his best form has come over shorter.

RaceName: A1R Services Ltd Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: 1-21; has been placed a few times on turf but his best form has come on the AW, albeit he was well held at Wolverhampton (1m4f) on Friday; others stronger.

RaceName: A1R Services Ltd Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Patchy form since joining this yard and well behind I'd Go Maniac on his return from five months off at Epsom (1m4f, good to firm) 18 days ago, but is 9lb lower than when winning at Newbury (1m4f, good to firm) for Ian Williams a year ago; first-time tongue-tie.

RaceName: A1R Services Ltd Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Has run well on good to firm but looks best on a softer surface; either way a record of 2-49 sounds a note of caution; out of the weights.

RaceName: A1R Services Ltd Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Ran with some credit on his return from 100 days off when fourth of 11 at Chepstow (1m2f, good to soft) seven weeks ago, but now 0-27 and is well out of the weights.

RaceName: Wasdell Group Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 60,000euros foal, 70,000euros yearling who's the first offspring of a French 6f-7f winner; trainer's strike-rate with 2yos is up a touch this season and he's 26% with them here; she's a likely looking newcomer.

RaceName: Wasdell Group Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 50,000gns yearling who's the first foal of a French 7f winner and holds a few sales race entries; trainer enjoyed a good spell with 2yos of late and she's interesting under Oisin Murphy (18-98 for the yard).

RaceName: Wasdell Group Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Just a fair debut at Yarmouth in late June (6f), when hitting a bit of traffic behind Rocsane (race won by subsequent Super Sprint winner Zigazig Ah); entitled to improve for a yard that's had a quiet year so far with juveniles.

RaceName: Wasdell Group Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Slowly away when finishing a remote last on her Tapeta debut 11 days ago; will need to leave that well behind for a trainer who's 2-23 with 2yos here.

RaceName: Wasdell Group Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 1,000gns foal who's the first offspring of an unraced sister to two winners over hurdles; trainer has a 7% strike-rate with 2yos here; would want to see good support on debut before considering her.

RaceName: Wasdell Group Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Inclined to hang on her first two runs and continued the steady progression when having Decem Carolinae behind at Yarmouth five weeks ago; a lot of years since her trainer had a 2yo win on turf but she sets the standard the newcomers are gunning for.

RaceName: Wasdell Group Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Stamina in her pedigree; never involved after a slow start on her 5f debut for Richard Hughes here seven weeks ago; prominent in the market that day, though, and interesting to see how she goes in the betting for her new yard (0-44 with 2yos here all told).

RaceName: Wasdell Group EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Huge prices when tailed off at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) and here (1m2f, good to firm) last month; drops dramatically in trip and makes no appeal.

RaceName: Wasdell Group EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Had major issues at the start in his first two outings and achieved little when beaten 10l into second of three at Lingfield (6f, good to firm; first-time blinkers) 12 days ago; bred to be better than that, but best watched for now.

RaceName: Wasdell Group EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Sent off 40-1 for her Leicester debut (6f, good to firm) ten weeks ago, but ran well to be beaten less than 2l into fourth of ten (winner has gone in again since); absence is a slight concern, but she still makes more appeal than most.

RaceName: Wasdell Group EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Has shown ability in her four starts as when fourth of seven in a first-time tongue-tie at Ffos Las (5f, good; first start since wind surgery) last month; others are still preferred, though, with low-grade handicaps looking a better option.

RaceName: Wasdell Group EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Well beaten in two starts on the AW (5f/6f) more than 15 months apart (debut was for Mark Usher); best watched for now.

RaceName: Wasdell Group EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Int Plywood (lmporters) Ltd And C Mason
Spotlight: 66-1 when a well-beaten sixth of seven on her Ffos Las debut (5f, good) last month (around 4l behind Gris De Chine).

RaceName: Wasdell Group EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Was finishing fourth for the third consecutive time when filling that position on handicap debut at Kempton (6f, AW) last month; doesn't shape as though the drop to 5f is a positive, but her form still makes her a major player in this field; tongue-tie given a go.

RaceName: Wasdell Group EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Twice runner-up on the AW at Lingfield (5f/6f), but failed to beat a rival back on turf there (6f, good to firm) nine days ago; however, the return to the minimum trip does look a positive so she may be worth chancing.

RaceName: Happy Birthday Tyne Patterson Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Eight-time winner in Ireland but all over 7f/1m, and three starts over 6f/7f for this yard have yielded little; takes another drop in class but best watched for now.

RaceName: Happy Birthday Tyne Patterson Fillies' Handicap
OwnerName: Nick Bradley Racing 16 And Jmr Partners
Spotlight: Made the most of her declining mark when regaining winning form off 2lb lower at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) last month; lost her race at the start at Bath a fortnight later and a major player if breaking on terms this time.

RaceName: Happy Birthday Tyne Patterson Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Won a maiden over C&D (good) for the Kublers a year ago and only just beaten on her reappearance/stable debut at Goodwood (6f, soft) in June, but well beaten at Leicester (6f, good to firm) last month; may not want the ground this quick, but still a player if bouncing back in first-time cheekpieces.

RaceName: Happy Birthday Tyne Patterson Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Seven-race maiden who showed ability in her early starts last year, but seems to have lost her way including in both outings since returning in June; Oisin Murphy regains the ride but the filly still needs a resurgence.

RaceName: Happy Birthday Tyne Patterson Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time course winner (5f/6f) whose form has been mixed since returning to turf in May, but this front-runner may enjoy the run of the race and she remains on a favourable mark; goes especially well on good to firm ground; much respected.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Running well in this headgear lately, winning a 0-60 handicap at Bath (1m, good) in June and keeping on to finish a close third in a similar contest to this at Lingfield (1m, AW) three weeks ago; didn't stay 1m4f in one attempt but should be fine at this trip; player.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Landed a similar contest at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) in January, but that her only success in her last 25 starts; could go well but others preferred for the win.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 0-16 but looked unlucky not to finish closer when third of nine in a 0-70 handicap at Epsom (8.5f, good to firm) last time; not certain to back that up but would be a player if he can.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: On a losing run of 18 but does know how to win and drops below 0-60 level for the first time; each-way claims; stable also runs Maryland Star.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 0-11; has run with credit in a couple of fast-ground handicaps over this trip in recent months, but still looks up against it on these terms.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 0-9; may have been flattered when third of six in a 0-55 handicap at Leicester (1m, good to firm) 12 days ago; drops in grade but others are more convincing.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Ex-Irish gelding who ran with a bit of credit when fourth of ten in a similar contest at Ffos Las (1m2f, good) last time, but has yet to be placed in 12 starts; hood will need to make a difference.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 0-5 but not disgraced in a couple of 0-55 handicaps; still unexposed and shortlisted with a first-time tongue-tie added to the usual hood.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Seven-race maiden who hinted at ability in a couple of maidens but hasn't built on it in handicaps, including when fitted with a hood last time; makes limited appeal despite the drop in grade.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Successfully dropped to this level when off the mark at the 17th attempt at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) on Saturday; major player if turning out again.

RaceName: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
Spotlight: First and second in two nurseries at Bath (1m, soft) last October, but not much otherwise including in both starts since returning in June; drop in grade the one positive.

RaceName: Talk Sport Radio Handicap
Spotlight: All five wins have been for previous trainers over 6f/7f; his two runs over 1m have not proved his stamina for the distance, but this does represent a class drop so all is not lost.

RaceName: Talk Sport Radio Handicap
Spotlight: Sole success came in a Nottingham maiden in 2024 when trained by David Evans; switched yards this year and best run since when runner-up at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) 11 days ago; Billy Loughnane rides for the first time and he should be thereabouts.

RaceName: Talk Sport Radio Handicap
Spotlight: Sole handicap success came at Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW) last November off 1lb higher, and she has returned to form in her last two starts; down to a career-low mark and holds place claims.

RaceName: Talk Sport Radio Handicap
Spotlight: Both wins have been on AW; raced too freely on return to action when sixth of seven over C&D (good to firm) two weeks ago and needs to settle better to give himself a chance.

RaceName: Talk Sport Radio Handicap
Spotlight: Previously trained in Ireland; all seven wins have been on AW, the latest being a claimer at Dundalk when last seen in March; probably best watched on stable debut unless the market suggests otherwise.

RaceName: Talk Sport Radio Handicap
Spotlight: Confirmed the promise of recent runs when scoring for the second time at Bath (1m, firm) last month; 5lb rise makes this tougher but holds place claims at least.

RaceName: Talk Sport Radio Handicap
Spotlight: Placed on his first two runs this year but last two runs not so good; three of his four turf wins have been at Bath, and may be best to wait until he returns to that venue.

RaceName: Talk Sport Radio Handicap
Spotlight: 0-11 but has performed with credit on all four starts this year for current trainer; back on the same mark as when beaten a neck at Bath (1m, good to soft) in April; first-time cheekpieces are now applied and she should run well.

RaceName: Talk Sport Radio Handicap
Spotlight: Both wins have been over 7f on AW; looks in need of a drop in the weights and a drop back in trip on AW.
